response.sql:
WITH event_spend_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    link_to_event,
    SUM(spent) / SUM(amount) as spend_ratio
  FROM budget
  GROUP BY link_to_event
),
avg_ratio AS (
  SELECT AVG(spend_ratio) as avg_spend_ratio
  FROM event_spend_ratios
)
SELECT 
  e.link_to_event,
  e.spend_ratio,
  e.spend_ratio / ar.avg_spend_ratio as relative_ratio
FROM event_spend_ratios e
CROSS JOIN avg_ratio ar
ORDER BY relative_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The spend ratio for each event is the ratio of total spent to total amount (aggregated across all budget lines for that event), not an average of individual budget line spend ratios

alternatives.interpretation: Calculate the spend ratio per event as the average of individual budget line spend ratios: for each line compute spent/amount, then average those ratios per event
alternatives.sql:
WITH event_spend_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    link_to_event,
    AVG(spent / amount) as spend_ratio
  FROM budget
  WHERE amount IS NOT NULL AND amount != 0
  GROUP BY link_to_event
),
avg_ratio AS (
  SELECT AVG(spend_ratio) as avg_spend_ratio
  FROM event_spend_ratios
)
SELECT 
  e.link_to_event,
  e.spend_ratio,
  e.spend_ratio / ar.avg_spend_ratio as relative_ratio
FROM event_spend_ratios e
CROSS JOIN avg_ratio ar
ORDER BY relative_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
